beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Shapes have names. Flat shapes lie on the page.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: A side is straight. A corner is where sides meet.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: One, two, three sides. Triangle.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Bigger. Smaller. Turn it. Change its color.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Three sides, whatever its size or direction.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Circle. It is round, with no straight sides and no corners.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: That looks like a diamond to me.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Count its sides.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: One, two, three, four. All the same length.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Its corners are square, like the corners of a book.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Turn it. It's a square.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Rectangle. One, two, three, four sides. Four square corners.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: A square is a special rectangle: all four sides match.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Hexagon. One, two, three, four, five, six straight sides.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Stretch it out. Still six sides, still a hexagon.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: A cube is a solid. It takes up space.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: A sugar cube has this shape.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Its flat faces are squares.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Trace one face. The square is flat; the cube is solid.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: A circle is flat.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: A sphere is round every way, like an orange.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: A cylinder is shaped like a soup can.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: The top is a flat circle.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Squeeze the top to a point. Now it's a cone, like a party hat.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: How many of these shapes are solid?

do.text: How many of these shapes are solid?

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: The rectangle is flat. It lies on the page.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: The shoebox shape takes up space. One.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: The cone, too. Two solids.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Which shape is a hexagon?

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: A hexagon has six sides. I'll count the middle one.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: One, two, three, four, five, six. The middle shape is a hexagon.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Five sides make a pentagon. Eight sides make an octagon.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Turn a shape over, or change its size: its name stays the same.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Count the sides. Flat lies on the page.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Solid takes up space.
